title: SKE Crystal Fresh Mojito Menthol Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Fresh Mojito Menthol flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts captures the essence of the classic Mojito cocktail with a bracing menthol twist. It combines the invigorating flavours of fresh mint and zesty lime, rounded off with a cooling menthol finish to create a lively and sophisticated vape experience. This e-liquid brings the cocktail hour spirit of a Mojito right to your vape, perfect for those who appreciate a complex vape juice flavour with a crisp, cooling sensation. The addition of nicotine salts enhances the smoothness of the throat hit, making it a suitable choice for those looking to transition from smoking to vaping. The 50VG/50PG blend ensures a well-balanced vape, providing ample flavour and cloud production, suitable for various MTL devices. Enjoy the taste of summer all year round with this uniquely refreshing blend. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
